statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Tail 9% sits at the low end of the low band, far below the 25% block threshold, while Stress 45% reflects a genuinely difficult yield and inflation backdrop.
recommendation: Tail remains below the watch threshold, so the mapped state is EA_ON for both NQ futures and the NAS100 CFD. The published danger window is narrow and covers the 13:05 UTC Williams speech, the 06 October US cash open and the first full cash hour, where continuation from a record close is the main conditional checkpoint. Elevated Stress alongside low Tail describes a volatile but still mean-reverting environment.
headline: NQ holds an unchanged 60-point Globex range at 31,364.25 after the record NDX close; Tail eases to 9% with the 10-year at 5.31%.
body: The NDX cash session closed at a record 31,076.44 on 5 October, up 268.51 points (+0.87%) from a 30,807.93 previous close, within a 30,798.42-31,117.36 range whose high matched the 52-week high. Nvidia reached an all-time high near $237 and Taiwan Semiconductor touched an intraday record after Elon Musk confirmed early-stage Terafab collaboration talks, with megacap technology and semiconductors leading while the Dow added only 0.2%. Since the 22:00 UTC Globex reopen NQ futures have held a 31,325.50-31,385.25 range and trade at 31,364.25 (+0.15%); that 59.75-point range is 0.19% of index value and has not widened for a second consecutive hour, with price about two thirds up the range rather than at an extreme. The live Asian handover is orderly: the Nikkei 225 is up 0.21% at 70,096.96 inside a 69,813.16-70,139.84 range and the ASX 200 up 0.28% at 8,710.70. The advance continues to occur against bond weakness rather than with it. The 10-year rose 3bp to 5.31% within a 5.26-5.35 range, close to its highest since 2002, while H.15 for 2 October shows the 2-year at 4.83%, the 30-year at 5.63% and effective fed funds at 3.88%. VIX closed at 15.52 in a 15.48-16.38 range. WTI is near $89.31 and Brent $100.32, roughly flat after two losing sessions as Middle East exports approach pre-war levels, which removes rather than adds a geopolitical amplifier. September ISM Services came in at 54.9 with its prices component at 74.0, signalling elevated cost pressure. The result is a directional cash uptrend without confirming cross-asset alignment, plus a contained and non-expanding overnight range, which the contract treats as a conviction and Stress question rather than evidence of mean-reversion failure, so Tail stays in the low band. The shared Finviz context file is dated 29 September and marked partial, so it was not used; this assessment rests on independent current research.

lookbackSummary: The preceding 24 published hours open at Tail 14% in the Asian session, decay to a 6% low at 08:00 UTC, then rebuild through the European and US cash sessions as megacap and semiconductor leadership firmed. The 19:00 UTC hour reached Tail 20% and the only WATCH state of the window during the late-session advance to the record close, before easing to 17%, 14%, 11% and 10% after the cash close. Stress fell steadily from 64% to a 46% trough around midday, rebuilt into the mid-50s through the US session, and closed the window at 46%. Confidence held in the 85-89% band throughout. The 06:00 UTC slot has no published assessment and remains explicitly unavailable.
outlookSummary: The next 24 hours cover the remaining Asian session, the European cash session and the 06 October US cash session. Conditional Tail sits at an 8-9% floor through the thin overnight and late-Asian hours, rises through the European open into the low teens, and peaks at 15% and 16% for the 13:00 and 14:00 UTC hours containing the Williams speech, the US cash open and the first full cash hour, where continuation from a record close is the main conditional route to mean-reversion failure. It then decays through US midday before rising modestly for the 17:00 UTC three-year note auction, which matters more than usual with the 10-year near its highest since 2002, and again for the power-hour stretch that produced the only WATCH state of the preceding window. Every forecast hour maps to EA_ON and green because no amplifier has actually been observed; Stress carries the yield, auction and inflation risk and peaks at 52% alongside the cash open. Conditional Tail is not an assertion that any of this structure already exists.
